assertions.name: phase_5l_2_simple_reconciliation_refuted
assertions.source:
Phase 5l.2 reconciliation probe: tested two simple hypotheses for relating Phase 5l.1's symbolic T(B_p, q) (Wenzl-bridge SYMBOLIC) to canonical tr_M^3(𝓑_p, q) (Phase 5l, mpfr-50-dps NUMERIC):
  Hyp A: T evaluated at q — rel.spread = 5.9127e-02
  Hyp B: T evaluated at q^2 — rel.spread = 8.0881e-01
Both spreads exceed 0.1% across the 5-point substrate window, refuting the simple-multiplicative-constant hypothesis for both q and q^2 interpretations.  The Wenzl-bridge symbolic implementation uses a deeper convention mismatch — likely a different normalization of y_λ that depends on partition structure as well as q.  Verdict: both-hypotheses-falsified.  Reconciliation now queued as a research task (no longer a simple normalization-constant fix).

description: Phase 5l.2: normalization reconciliation between the Phase 5l.1 structural T(B_p, q) (Wenzl-bridge symbolic) and the canonical Phase 5l tr_M^3(𝓑_p, q) (mpfr-50-dps numeric).  Tests two hypotheses: (A) the ratio tr_M^3(𝓑_p, q) / T(B_p, q) is q-independent (simple multiplicative constant); (B) the symbolic T uses Q = q^2 convention, so tr_M^3(𝓑_p, q) / T(B_p, q^2) is q-independent.  If either holds, gives the closed-form normalization for promoting Phase 5l.1's symbolic T to canonical tr_M^3.
